documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Coforge reported its Q2 FY2027 financial and operational results, highlighting record quarterly large deals and robust order intake exceeding $1 billion. Management upgraded the consolidated EBIT margin guidance for fiscal year 2027 to 16% and expects reported Q4 EBIT to reach 17%. The company noted strong adoption of enterprise AI initiatives and highlighted that the Encora acquisition is performing ahead of plans on margins and deal momentum. Furthermore, free cash flow conversion to PAT is guided at 100% for the full year. Management presented an investor update on September 17, 2026, regarding its 'Operationalizing Enterprise Autonomy - Coforge Vantage Series' webinar and the Coforge Nuuron autonomous AI enablement suite.

guidance.claim: The company raised its consolidated EBIT margin guidance for fiscal year 2027 to 16%.
guidance.quote: We are pleased to raise our consolidated EBIT margin guidance for fiscal year 2027 to 16%, from the 15.5% we had shared at the beginning of the year.

guidance.claim: Management plans to achieve a reported Q4 EBIT of 17%.
guidance.quote: We also plan to achieve a reported Q4 EBIT of 17%, thereby establishing the glide path to further and significant margin expansion in fiscal year 2028 as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects free cash flow to PAT conversion to be 100% for the year.
guidance.quote: Short note, we expect it to be 100% for the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margin to remain in the 20.5% to 21% range.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of the guidance of 20.5% to 21% range.

guidance.claim: Management expects Encora’s revenue growth to mirror Coforge’s growth from Q3 onwards.
guidance.quote: as we had said last quarter in the investor call we continue to expect Encora’s revenue growth to mirror Coforge’s growth from Q3 onwards.

guidance.claim: The combined entity in FY27 shall deliver 15.5% reported EBIT.
guidance.quote: We had also said that we will immediately expand Encora margins too, and that the combined entity in FY27 shall deliver 15.5% reported EBIT.

guidance.claim: We are confident of achieving an EBITDA margin of 20.5 to 21% on a consolidated basis.
guidance.quote: The outlook for FY27 that we had shared last quarter remains unchanged. We are confident of achieving an EBITDA margin of 20.5 to 21% on a consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: EBIT margins are expected to be in the range of 16.5 to 17% on a standalone basis, and 15.5% or higher on a consolidated basis.
guidance.quote: EBIT margins are expected to be in the range of 16.5 to 17% on a standalone basis, and 15.5% or higher on a consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: FCF to PAT for the year will be 100%+.
guidance.quote: FCF to PAT for the year will be 100%+.

guidance.claim: Standalone Coforge standalone EBIT will jump to between 16.5 to 17%.
guidance.quote: Last year Coforge reported an EBIT of 14.4%. We had shared with you that this year, standalone Coforge standalone EBIT will jump to between 16.5 to 17%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Coforge will be the industry growth leader for the third consecutive year.
demand_outlook.quote: This year, we will be the industry growth leader for the third consecutive year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the industry faces acute pricing pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: This improvement in margin, at a time when our industry faces acute pricing pressure, is driven by our execution ethos.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that most large deals are sole-sourced and driven by proactive solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Most of our large deals are sole-sourced and driven by proactive solutions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that procurement-driven RFPs have slowed down.
demand_outlook.quote: We have a very strong collective belief across the firm that the demand slowdown that we are talking about is largely on account of the fact that the procurement-driven RFPs have slowed down.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that AI spend is entering its metered era.
demand_outlook.quote: AI spend is entering its metered era.

demand_outlook.claim: The pipeline of large deals has never been stronger than it is today.
demand_outlook.quote: Our pipeline of large deals – short term, medium term and long term – has never been stronger than it is today.

demand_outlook.claim: For Coforge the demand tailwind is structural and pure.
demand_outlook.quote: As we had shared last time, for Coforge the demand tailwind is structural and pure.

capex_expansion.claim: During FY26, we invested approximately $58 million in AI innovation.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY26, we invested approximately $58 million in AI innovation.

capex_expansion.claim: As part of the Encora transaction, the company recorded approximately $480 million of customer relationship intangibles.
capex_expansion.quote: Moving on to Balance Sheet, as part of the Encora transaction, the company recorded approximately $480 million of customer relationship intangibles, which will be amortized over 12 years, resulting in a charge of approximately $40 million per year within the depreciation and amortization line.

capex_expansion.claim: For the Encora acquisition, we had taken a term loan of $550 million.
capex_expansion.quote: On term loans, as you will recall, for the Encora acquisition, we had taken a term loan of $550 million.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBIT margin for the quarter stood at 16%.
margins_costs.quote: Equally importantly, we delivered a consolidated EBIT margin of 16%, above our current guidance of 15.5%, while the standalone business delivered an EBIT margin of 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Combined G&A improved further to 6.3% in the current quarter versus 6.6% in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Following the 40% reduction in Encora G&A in Q1, the full quarter benefit of the cost actions is now visible with combined G&A improving further to 6.3% in the current quarter versus 6.6% in the previous quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Hedge losses for the current quarter stood at $10.2 million.
margins_costs.quote: Hedge losses for the current quarter stood at $10.2 million, broadly in line with Q1 FY2027.

margins_costs.claim: On mark-to-market basis, the company expects a loss of $7.1 million in Q3 and $1.2 million in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: On mark-to-market basis, we expect loss of $7.1 million in Q3 and $1.2 million in Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone Q1FY27 EBIT was reported at 16.7%.
Consolidated EBIT margin came in at 16%, while organic EBIT margin was 16.7%.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated EBIT margin came in at 16%, while organic EBIT margin was 16.7%.

margins_costs.claim: Within its first quarter as part of Coforge, Encora delivered EBITDA margin of 20.3% and EBIT margin of 19.1%.
margins_costs.quote:
Within its first quarter as part of Coforge, Encora delivered:
• EBITDA margin of 20.3%
• EBIT margin of 19.1%

margins_costs.claim: The combined organization is now at 6.6% for Q1 FY27 from a G&A standpoint, representing a reduction of 40% in Encora G&A.
margins_costs.quote: The combined organization is now at 6.6% for Q1 FY27 from a G&A standpoint. This represents a reduction of 40% in Encora G&A.

margins_costs.claim: The hedge losses incurred during the current quarter amounted to $10 million.
margins_costs.quote: The hedge losses incurred during the current quarter amounted to $10 million.

margins_costs.claim: We have a Mark-to-Market (MTM) loss of $14 million on account of outstanding hedges, which will be realized over the next two quarters.
margins_costs.quote: Additionally, we have a Mark-to-Market (MTM) loss of $14 million on account of outstanding hedges, which will be realized over the next two quarters.

margins_costs.claim: Exceptional expenses and acquisition-related expenses recognized during the current quarter amounted to $6.5 million.
margins_costs.quote: Exceptional expenses and acquisition-related expenses recognized during the current quarter amounted to $6.5 million, compared with $5.4 million in Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: Order intake for the quarter exceeded US$1 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: I wish to share that our order intake for the quarter, for the second time in our history as a firm, is more than US$1 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Eight large deals were signed during the quarter, which is the highest number of large deals signed in any quarter in company history.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q2, we signed eight large deals, this is the highest number of large deals we have signed in any quarter in our history.

orders_capacity.claim: Total headcount stands at 47,365 and the utilization rate stands at a healthy 82.4%.
orders_capacity.quote: we added 1137 employees, the total headcount now stands at 47,365 and the utilization rate stands at a healthy 82.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total order intake during the quarter stood at US$691 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Total order intake during the quarter stood at US$691 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Our next 12-month executable order book expanded to an all-time high of US$2.23 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our next 12-month executable order book expanded to an all-time high of US$2.23 billion, compared with US$1.55 billion a year ago—an increase of 44.2% year on year, providing strong visibility for the year ahead.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, we signed four large deals.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we signed four large deals.
Utilization remained healthy at 82.5%, while last-12-month attrition declined further to 10.4%, remaining among the lowest in the industry.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow to PAT came in at 90% for the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: FCF to PAT came in at 90% for the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The combined organization generated free cash flow of $52.9 million in Q1, representing an FCF-to-PAT conversion of 95.3%.
capital_allocation.quote: Moving to cash flows, the combined organization generated free cash flow of $52.9 million in Q1, representing an FCF-to-PAT conversion of 95.3%, compared with -ve 56.5% in Q1 of the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The loan has a three-year tenure and carries a post-tax interest cost of 2.99% per annum.
capital_allocation.quote: The loan has a three-year tenure and carries a post-tax interest cost of 2.99% per annum.

risks_headwinds.claim: From a geographic perspective, Rest of the World segment contracted 22.0%, reflecting the impact of the portfolio exits discussed earlier.
risks_headwinds.quote: From a geographic perspective, organic growth was led by EMEA and the Americas, which grew 8.4% and 3.5% sequentially in constant-currency terms, respectively. Rest of the World segment contracted 22.0%, reflecting the impact of the portfolio exits discussed earlier.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to achieve a reported Q4 EBIT of 17%.
management_commitments.quote: We also plan to achieve a reported Q4 EBIT of 17%, thereby establishing the glide path to further and significant margin expansion in fiscal year 2028 as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects FCF to PAT conversion guidance of 100% for FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: We remain confident of delivering FCF to PAT guidance of 100% for FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: We remain on track to deliver EPS accretion in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As guided earlier, we remain on track to deliver EPS accretion in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: We remain confident of meeting our FY27 free cash flow-to-PAT guidance of 100%.
management_commitments.quote: We remain confident of meeting our FY27 free cash flow-to-PAT guidance of 100%.

management_commitments.claim: We expect marginal integration costs in Q2 and none from Q3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: We expect marginal integration costs in Q2 and none from Q3 onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
